model: finite deterministic unit-cost guaranteed binary-target resolution; universal fixed comparator

sharp_global_expected_ceiling.proof_bound: For C_F>1, a binary root can have at most one target-pure outcome; its one-step probability is at most the majority target-class prevalence. Ternary may have two pure root outcomes plus one mixed continuation.

conclusion: K=0.68 exceeds the global binary ceiling but is below the ternary witness value, despite exactly balanced target prevalence.
claim_ceiling: Supremal task-design existence with freely adjustable within-target encounter frequencies, not an empirical sensory-fitness estimate. Three-way definite/uncertain triage is known prior art.
